your_games.title: Witcher 3 Remastered: PS5 hotfix 5.01b
your_games.body: CD Projekt Red pushed a ~500MB stability hotfix (update 5.000.500) for The Witcher 3 Remastered on PS5 and PS5 Pro. There are no itemised notes beyond "various stability improvements", and MP1st says some players still report crashes. Patch 5.01 for Switch 2 is still in the works with no date.

your_games.title: Helldivers 2: Scope of Authority Warbond on 20 Oct
your_games.body: Arrowhead's next Premium Warbond is all about long range: the R-40 Sightliner bolt-action sniper, P-44 Mist machine pistol, backpack-fed AMW-20 Apex anti-materiel rifle, LAS-44 Nova charge rifle and G-11 Caltrops. Both new armours carry the Stationary Shroud passive, which cuts sway and detection range while crouched or prone. It's separate from Update 7.2, which still has no date.

your_games.title: GTA 6 on PC in early 2027, report says
your_games.body: GamesBeat, citing four industry sources, reports GTA 6 will hit PC within the first three months of 2027. Rockstar hasn't commented. The console launch on PS5 and Xbox Series is still 19 Nov.

your_games.title: Modern Warfare 4 early access dates
your_games.body: Activision's Battle.net post confirms Campaign Early Access from Friday 16 Oct for digital pre-orders. DMZ reportedly opens to pre-order players on 20 Oct, and Infinity Ward says it won't have a solo PvE mode, though you can switch off squad fill. Full launch is 23 Oct.

your_games.title: Pikmin 4 Switch 2 Edition on 12 Nov
your_games.body: Pikmin 4: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy lands a week before GTA 6, with better visuals, voice commands for Oatchi, Dandori Academy exams and GameShare Dandori Battles. Owners of the Switch version can upgrade for $9.99.

your_games.title: Three more GBA games on Switch Online
your_games.body: Monster Rancher Advance, Metal Slug Advance and the once Japan-only Kururin Paradise are now in the Game Boy Advance library for Switch Online + Expansion Pack members on Switch and Switch 2.

industry.title: Boltgun 2 is out today
industry.body: Auroch Digital's retro Warhammer 40K shooter launches today with two playable characters (Ultramarine Malum Caedo and Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath) and a branching campaign. The PlayStation Store lists unlock at 16:00 UTC (18:00 SAST) and £19.99 in the UK. A Switch 2 version comes later.

industry.title: Xbox forms Xbox Labs
industry.body: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma told staff that CTO Scott Van Vliet will lead a small team exploring things like AI-driven decompiles, ports to new hardware and browser versions of games, after a wave of fan-made AI ports. She said Xbox will build in the open and share its tools with other developers.

industry.title: Edge of Memories slips to 3 Dec
industry.body: Nacon and Midgar Studio pushed the Edge of Eternity follow-up action RPG from 5 Nov to 3 Dec to avoid the crowded launch window. Digital pre-orders move over automatically, and an updated Steam demo returns in early November.

industry.title: ARC Raiders tries a PvE beta
industry.body: Embark added a separate PvE-only matchmaking toggle on all platforms until 20 Oct. Loot is worth less there, and some conditions like Frigate, Night Raid and Locked Gate aren't available.

industry.title: Big Steam client update
industry.body: Valve's latest Steam update has a long changelog, including a bouncing-logo screensaver and an experimental Pyrowave video codec for high-bandwidth, low-latency Remote Play streaming.

industry.title: DLSS 5 toned down for Hogwarts Legacy
industry.body: Nvidia's DLSS 5 arrives in Hogwarts Legacy on PC on 5 Nov with much subtler face changes than its controversial March showing. It's PC only, so nothing changes on PS5.

releases.title: Enshrouded 1.0
releases.note: Survival crafting leaves early access; Sparkworks tools

releases.title: It Takes Two
releases.note: Free Switch upgrade; Friend's Pass; cross-play

footer_note: Still waiting: RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0.1 (save restores) was promised for this week but has no date yet, and Helldivers 2 Update 7.2 is still unnamed and undated. The full PS Plus Extra/Premium October line-up is expected to be revealed today; Mycopunk (20 Oct) is the only confirmed game so far.
